details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:53-60 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `update-wrappers` job lost its `if: ${{ inputs.allow_workflow_edits != false }}` gate, so the release smoke dispatch in test-and-mark-stable.yml:4242-4270 (allow_workflow_edits=false, TEST_REPO defaulting to this repo) now runs the full wrapper sync and commit/PR path.
  WHY: The release rehearsal can create or update wrappers and open or push update PRs in the source repo, the "destructive feedback loop" the smoke step says the flag prevents. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 and gemini rated MAJOR, minimax, luna and glm BLOCKER; highest used.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:88-104 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: docs/INVENTORY.md "## Workflows" omits the new .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py fails in CI ("missing .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml"), which turns the tests-release-and-log-analysis job and the aggregate gate red.
- agents.md:4915-4945 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The auto-generated TREE blocks (id=workflows, id=workflow_templates) were not regenerated and omit .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml and workflow-templates/ai-workflow-integrity.yml.
  WHY: `make generate-check` fails with "agents.md is out of date; run make generate", so static-checks and the aggregate gate are red.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:186-211 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The drift audit compares normalized text (managed header, trailing whitespace and CRLF stripped), while workflow_integrity.yml:290-306 compares raw bytes.
  WHY: A wrapper differing only in those parts counts as in sync, so no restore PR opens, yet the integrity check fails it, and the repair cannot fix it. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT, the others MAJOR; highest used.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:793-800 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_open_pulls` reads one page of 100 open PRs with no pagination, and that page decides both "a sync PR is open" and "restore PR exists".
  WHY: With more than 100 open PRs, the sync-PR skip or the existing restore PR can be missed, and the POST then fails with 422 recorded as repair_failed.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:838-851,886-898 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The code force-pushes to the fixed branch auto/restore-managed-workflows whenever it exists remotely, checking the ownership marker only on open PRs, not on the branch.
  WHY: A consumer's own branch or PR head with that name is overwritten, because the lease uses the tip just read. Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT, the others MAJOR; highest used.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:7-11,27-31 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `allow_workflow_edits` description still says "Allow automatic workflow wrapper updates" although the input no longer gates wrapper updates.
  WHY: Operators and consumers' copied ai-update-workflows.yml see misleading input help.
- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:198-209 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: git ls-tree is run without -r and the filter only matches entries directly under .github/workflows/, so the extracted tree is empty and detect() skips verification.
  WHY: The integrity check would never verify wrapper files. Sonnet-5_5, minimax and glm checked this claim and dropped it as wrong.
- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:688-695 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The required status context is not bound to this workflow, so another workflow with `statuses: write` can post `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity` for the same commit.
  WHY: A ruleset requiring the context from the GitHub Actions app accepts either status, so a wrapper change can merge despite integrity failure (README.md:1343-1345 documents this).
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:793-800,916-924 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The restore PR lookup uses state=open only, so after a restore PR is closed unmerged the persistent head branch makes the next POST fail with 422 (repair_failed).
  WHY: Daily repair then fails permanently for that consumer. Sonnet-5_5 checked this claim and dropped it as unsupported.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:SSE:.github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:59-72 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The daily audit extracts and executes code (load_renderer via exec_module, audit_consumer_drift.py:711-719, 1008-1012) from the mutable stable tag without the attestation check the sync performs.
  WHY: audit_consumer_drift.yml:42 puts GH_PAT in the environment, so a moved tag would run unreviewed code with the PAT and push its templates into every consumer.
- .github/workflows/audit_consumer_drift.yml:schedule/report step | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The daily audit repairs drift itself but still pages at WARNING on every run that sees drift.
  WHY: A consumer whose restore PR awaits human merge pages daily, against the Telegram alert-level convention.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:RESTORE_COMMIT_AUTHOR | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Restore commits are authored as github-actions[bot] while the push authenticates as the GH_PAT account.
  WHY: Commit history and blame attribute restore commits to an identity that did not write them.
- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:241-258 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `detect()` adds every workflow that calls an upstream reusable workflow to the candidate set, so a PR adding its own upstream-calling workflow triggers full signed-release verification.
  WHY: Such PRs pay the verification cost and can fail on transient release-asset or API errors although no managed wrapper changed.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Consumer repos can no longer change the managed workflow wrappers" (the coding-workflows/workflow-integrity status must be enforced via the ruleset)
  expected_change_site: consumer default-branch ruleset provisioning (e.g. a script over .github/ai/consumer_repos.json), or an UNSET_OPERATOR_STEP placeholder registered in agents.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no diff hunk in .github/workflows/ or scripts/ creates or updates a ruleset, agents.d/8065-managed-wrapper-integrity.md:4 says the ruleset is applied by hand, README.md:1331-1341 describes manual application, so the status stays advisory for every consumer
- requirement: The new workflow must be added to docs/INVENTORY.md because it is a tracked workflow surface
  expected_change_site: docs/INVENTORY.md "## Workflows" section
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: no diff hunk touches docs/INVENTORY.md, CI tests/inventory_parity.py fails with "missing .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml"
- requirement: Regenerate the agents.md Repo-tree TREE blocks (id=workflows, id=workflow_templates) for the new workflow files
  expected_change_site: agents.md Repo-tree (auto-generated) TREE blocks
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: no diff hunk regenerates the TREE blocks, CI `make generate-check` fails with "agents.md is out of date; run make generate"
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:53-60 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Job-level `if: ${{ inputs.allow_workflow_edits != false }}` was removed, so the release smoke dispatch (test-and-mark-stable.yml:4242-4270) now runs wrapper sync and commit_push against TEST_REPO.
  WHY: Running in the source repo creates and updates ai-*.yml wrappers and opens auto/update-workflows-* PRs or pushes ai-sync/stable, and the gate (success,skipped) no longer exercises the safe path.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:186-208 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The audit treats CRLF, trailing-whitespace and managed-header-only differences as in sync, while the integrity check rejects any byte difference.
  WHY: No restore PR opens and the repair loop cannot fix it, until the next sync PR (which uses `cmp -s`) runs.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:DriftRepairer._open_pulls | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: One page of 100 open PRs with no pagination decides both the sync-PR skip and the existing restore PR.
  WHY: With more than 100 open PRs the POST fails with 422 and is recorded as repair_failed.
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:7-11,27-31 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `allow_workflow_edits` description is unchanged although the input no longer gates wrapper updates.
  WHY: Consumers see misleading input help.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:DriftRepairer._repair (git push --force-with-lease) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Force-pushes to the fixed branch name whenever it exists remotely, with the marker checked only on open PRs.
  WHY: A consumer's own branch with that name would be overwritten; this needs a name collision.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:"## Workflows" (line 103) / agents.md TREE blocks id=workflows, id=workflow_templates | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: (TASK_GAP) Requirement: the PR adds workflow_integrity.yml and documents it in README and agents.d, and the inventory is the authority for tracked workflows. Expected change site: docs/INVENTORY.md "## Workflows" and the agents.md TREE blocks. Evidence of absence: no diff hunk touches either, CI shows `tests/inventory_parity.py` failing and `make generate-check` failing.
  WHY: static-checks and tests-release-and-log-analysis are red.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:198-209 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: git ls-tree is run without -r and the filter only matches entries directly under .github/workflows/.
  WHY: The extracted tree is empty, so detect() skips verification.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:270-300 (load_expected_templates) and .github/workflows/workflow_integrity.yml:290-306 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The drift audit compares normalized text while the integrity check compares raw bytes.
  WHY: A wrapper can be in sync per the audit but rejected by the integrity check, a mismatch the repair cannot fix.
- scripts/audit_consumer_drift.py:794 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR listing is not paginated and is limited to 100 entries.
  WHY: With more than 100 open PRs an existing restore PR may be missed, and creating a new one fails with "A pull request already exists", recorded as an error.
